name: bollinger_ema_sar_v1b
session_rule: No hard 09:00-12:00 ET gate. NY anchor is contextual only. Strategy may operate across available futures sessions if all setup conditions are valid.

structure.causal_confirmation: A swing at bar j is usable only from bar j+2 onward.
structure.long_sequence: Bar before signal sweeps below latest confirmed swing low; signal bar has a higher low than that prior bar and closes back above the swept structure level.
structure.short_sequence: Bar before signal sweeps above latest confirmed swing high; signal bar has a lower high than that prior bar and closes back below the swept structure level.

market_regime_filter.slope_definition_v1b: EMA20 net movement over the last 5 closed bars must be >= 5% of current Bollinger bandwidth for LONG, or <= -5% for SHORT.
market_regime_filter.why_changed: V1 monotonic EMA20 on three consecutive transitions was too restrictive and produced only 6 trades. V1B changes only this regime filter; all other signal, stop, entry and exit rules remain fixed.
market_regime_filter.optimization: Threshold fixed before observing V1B results; do not tune inside this discovery run.

signal_candle.rocket_long: Green body and lower wick >= 70% of body size.
signal_candle.rocket_short: Red body and upper wick >= 70% of body size.
signal_candle.engulfing_long: Green body fully engulfs the prior candle body.
signal_candle.engulfing_short: Red body fully engulfs the prior candle body.

long: Prior bar sweeps below latest confirmed 2-2 swing low
Signal bar closes back above swept swing low
Prior bar or signal bar reaches/pierces lower Bollinger band
EMA20 is rising on each of the last 3 closed transitions
EMA3 crosses above EMA9 on the signal bar
Parabolic SAR is below the signal candle
Signal candle is rocket rejection or bullish body engulfing
short: Prior bar sweeps above latest confirmed 2-2 swing high
Signal bar closes back below swept swing high
Prior bar or signal bar reaches/pierces upper Bollinger band
EMA20 is falling on each of the last 3 closed transitions
EMA3 crosses below EMA9 on the signal bar
Parabolic SAR is above the signal candle
Signal candle is rocket rejection or bearish body engulfing

entry_execution.timing: Open of the bar immediately after the fully closed signal candle

stop.long: Low of the candle immediately before the signal candle
stop.short: High of the candle immediately before the signal candle

exit_v1.target: 40% of Bollinger bandwidth measured at signal close, projected from entry in trade direction
exit_v1.time_exit: Close of the third bar after entry if neither target nor stop was hit

ema50_ema200.role_v1: Recorded as context only, not mandatory entry gates

cost_model.note: Net-R subtracts 0.03R per trade for consistency with existing research conventions; gross metrics are also retained.

comparison.unchanged: Bollinger 20/2, EMA 3/9/20/50/200, PSAR, swing 2-2, sweep/reclaim, rocket/engulfing, next-bar entry, prior-to-signal stop, 40% BB target, 3-bar maximum hold, costs, sessions
